nodes.label: GLUE vault: project memory structure
nodes.rationale: Central index of GLUE's memory: SYSTEM, handoff, roadmap, features, ADRs, research, changelog

nodes.label: ADR 0127: Graphify code map for coding sessions
nodes.rationale: Coding sessions get a map of code: graphify knowledge graph of code and vault, built per computer

nodes.label: ADR 0128: Code map built on GitHub per push
nodes.rationale: Code map built on GitHub for every push (branch graphify); used by fixed rules: affected/explain/path

nodes.label: ADR 0129: Code map docs refreshed every session
nodes.rationale: Docs part refreshed per session via scripts/graph_docs.py; view on site at /graph/

nodes.label: ADR 0009: JSON files store, no database
nodes.rationale: JSON files in GLUE folder are store; no database (layout amended by 0018)

nodes.label: ADR 0036: Optional accounts and cloud signaling
nodes.rationale: Optional accounts and small free cloud service for devices and signaling; no library data in cloud (superseded by 0040, opt-in by 0101)

nodes.label: ADR 0101: Cloud sync is the account's collections
nodes.rationale: Cloud sync on means every collection is the account's; one sync only

nodes.label: ADR 0051: GLUE Home is local engine and disk
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home is computer's disk and engine; website stays at public address

nodes.label: ADR 0096: Move merged collections into shared one
nodes.rationale: Move merged collections into shared one, one computer at a time

nodes.label: ADR 0002: Static client-only app, no server
ADR 0010: Read-only import and export before write-back
nodes.rationale: Read-only import and file export before any write-back to DJ libraries

nodes.label: ADR 0013: Three tiers of duplicate detection
nodes.rationale: Fingerprints, three tiers of duplicate detection
